variations.text: 我很好，謝謝！你呢？
variations.textEn: I'm good, thank you! And you?
variations.phonetic: Wǒ hěn hǎo, xièxie! nǐ ne?

variations.text: 我很好，謝謝關心。你好嗎？
variations.textEn: I'm doing well, thank you for asking. How are you?
variations.phonetic: Wǒ hěn hǎo, xièxie guānxīn. Nǐ hǎo ma?

variations.text: 我叫[名字]。我來自[城市]。我正在[大學]讀[專業]。我喜歡[愛好]。
variations.textEn: My name is [Name]. I am from [City]. I am studying [Major] at [University]. I like [Hobby].
variations.phonetic: Wǒ jiào [name]. Wǒ láizì [city]. Wǒ zhèngzài [university] dú [major].

variations.text: 我叫[名字]。你可以叫我[暱稱]。
variations.textEn: My name is [Full Name]. You can call me [Nickname].
variations.phonetic: Wǒ jiào [name]. Nǐ kěyǐ jiào wǒ [nickname].

variations.text: 我是學生。我在[大學]讀[專業]。明年畢業。
variations.textEn: I am a student. I study [Major] at [University]. I will graduate next year.

variations.textEn: I studied [Major] at [University]. My favorite subject was [Subject] because [Reason].
variations.phonetic: Wǒ dú [major], zài [university]. Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de kēmù shì [subject].

variations.text: 是的，我明年[年份]畢業。我讀[科系]。
variations.textEn: Yes, I will graduate in [Year]. I studied [Major].
variations.phonetic: Shì de, wǒ míngnián [year] bìyè. Wǒ dú [major].

variations.text: 我學會了[技能1]和[技能2]。這些技能幫助我[用途]。
variations.textEn: I learned [Skill 1] and [Skill 2]. These skills help me [How you use them].
variations.phonetic: Wǒ xuéhuì le [skill 1] hé [skill 2]. Zhèxiē jìnéng bāngzhù wǒ [use].

variations.textEn: No, this is my first job. But I did [Project/Volunteer Work] and learned [Skills]. I am eager to learn.

variations.phonetic: Wǒ zài [company] zuò [role]. Wǒ de gōngzuò shì [duty].

questions.base: 為什麼離開上一份工作？
questions.baseEn: Why did you leave your last job?

variations.text: 我在[舊公司]學了很多。現在我想嘗試[新行業]，因為[原因]。我想找新的挑戰。
variations.textEn: I learned a lot at [Old Company]. Now I want to try [New Field] because [Reason]. I am looking for new challenges.
variations.phonetic: Wǒ zài [old company] xué le hěn duō. Xiànzài wǒ xiǎng chángshì [new field].

variations.textEn: I can do [Skill 1] and [Skill 2]. I am also good at [Skill 3]. I want to learn more about [New Skill].

variations.textEn: I know how to use [Software 1], [Software 2], and [Software 3]. I learned them at school/at my last job.

variations.textEn: My English level is [Level]. I can [What you can do] but I am still improving. I practice by [How you practice].
variations.phonetic: Wǒ de Yīngwén chéngdù shì [level]. Wǒ kěyǐ [what you can do].

variations.textEn: Yes, I like working with others. In my [Class/Job], I worked with [Number] people on [Project]. We [What you did together].
variations.phonetic: Shì de, wǒ xǐhuan hé bié rén hézuò. Zài [class] shí, wǒ hé [number] rén yìqǐ zuò [project].

questions.base: 你為什麼想應徵這份工作？
questions.baseEn: Why do you want this job?

variations.text: 我想做這份工作是因為我對[行業]有興趣。貴公司[公司優點]。我覺得可以在這裡學到很多。
variations.textEn: I want this job because I am interested in [Field]. Your company [Good Thing]. I think I can learn a lot here.
variations.phonetic: Wǒ xiǎng zuò zhè fèn gōngzuò shì yīnwèi wǒ duì [field] yǒu xìngqù.

variations.text: 我想做這份工作是因為它符合我的[技能]。這是個在[領域]成長的機會。貴公司的[優點]很吸引我。
variations.textEn: I want this job because it matches my skills in [Skill]. This is a chance to grow in [Area]. Your company's [Positive] attracts me.
variations.phonetic: Wǒ xiǎng zuò zhè fèn gōngzuò shì yīnwèi tā fúhé wǒ de [skill].

questions.baseEn: Do you know about our company?

variations.text: 我知道[公司名稱]是一家[公司類型]。你們有[人數]名員工。主要產品是[產品]。我很欣賞[公司成就]。
variations.textEn: I know that [Company Name] is a [Type of Business]. You have [Number] employees. Your main products are [Products]. I am impressed by [Achievement].
variations.phonetic: Wǒ zhīdào [company name] shì yì jiā [type]. Nǐmen yǒu [number] míng yuángōng.

variations.text: 是的，我可以做這份工作。我有[技能1]和[技能2]。我學得很快。如果有不知道的，我會問並學習。
variations.textEn: Yes, I can do this job. I have skills in [Skill 1] and [Skill 2]. I am a fast learner. If there is something I don't know, I will ask and learn.
variations.phonetic: Shì de, wǒ kěyǐ zuò zhè fèn gōngzuò. Wǒ yǒu [skill 1] hé [skill 2].

questions.base: 你什麼時候可以開始工作？

variations.text: 我可以[時間]開始。我需要[通知期]來離開現在的[學校/工作]。可以嗎？
variations.textEn: I can start in [Time]. I need [Notice Period] to leave my current [School/Job]. Is that okay?

questions.baseEn: Are you willing to work overtime?

variations.text: 是的，當有重要工作時我願意加班。但我認為平衡也很重要。我每週可以工作[小時]小時。
variations.textEn: Yes, I am willing to work extra hours when there is important work. But I also think balance is important. I can work [Hours] hours per week.
variations.phonetic: Shì de, dāng yǒu zhòngyào gōngzuò shí wǒ yuàn yì jiābān.

variations.textEn: Yes, I can work on weekends if needed. However, [Day] is difficult because [Reason]. Is that okay?
variations.phonetic: Shì de, rúguǒ xūyào wǒ kěyǐ zhōumò gōngzuò.

variations.phonetic: Wǔ nián hòu, wǒ xīwàng chéngwéi zhè jiā gōngsī de [job title].

variations.textEn: I see myself growing in this industry. I want to become an expert in [Area]. I plan to get [Certificate/Training] to help me achieve this.
variations.phonetic: Wǒ kàndao zìjǐ zài zhège hángyè chéngzhǎng.

variations.text: 我的短期目標是好好學會這份工作。我想要擅長[關鍵任務]。我的長期目標是[更大目標]。
variations.textEn: My short-term goal is to learn this job well. I want to be good at [Key Task]. My long-term goal is [Bigger Goal].
variations.phonetic: Wǒ de duǎnqī mùbiāo shì hǎohāo xuéhuì zhè fèn gōngzuò.

questions.baseEn: What do you want to learn?

variations.text: 有一次，我同學生病了。我幫他做作業。我[你做了什麼]。他說謝謝，然後[結果]。
variations.textEn: One time, my classmate was sick. I helped them with their work. I [What you did]. They said thank you and [Result].
